package.name: rp1_gps
package.description: rp1's config/launch for a u-blox NEO-F10N GNSS receiver (Dalang DL25F10NQ module) over UART, using the stock ublox_gps driver -- no custom driver code, this package is glue only. The module's onboard IST8310 compass is a separate I2C device handled by rp1_compass, not this package.
